items.headline: Sanders introduces Medicare for All Act for fifth consecutive Congress
items.summary: Senator Sanders reintroduced the Medicare for All Act of 2023 with 14 Senate cosponsors. The bill would eliminate private health insurance in favor of a government-administered program covering all U.S. residents.

source.name: Congress.gov

items.headline: FEC reports show Sanders 2024 fundraising relies on small-dollar donations
items.summary: Federal Election Commission quarterly filings show over 99% of Sanders campaign contributions come from individuals giving under $200, with an average donation of $27.
